title: NLMC Releases RFP for E-Auction of 11 Government Residential Flats Across Three Prime Locations in Prayagraj
subtitle:
Residential properties located at Muir Road, Thornhill Road and Civil Lines to be offered through a transparent and competitive e-auction process
Pre-Bid Meeting Scheduled for 20 November 2026; E-Auction to be Held on 11 December 2026
body_text: The National Land Monetization Corporation (NLMC), a wholly owned Government of India company under the administrative control of the Department of Public Enterprises (DPE), Ministry of Finance, has announced the release of the Request for Proposal (RFP) for the e-auction of 11 government-owned residential flats situated across three established housing schemes in Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh. The RFP, released on 5 November 2026, invites prospective homebuyers, individual investors and other eligible bidders to participate in a structured, transparent and competitive online auction process for acquiring residential properties in some of Prayagraj's well-established localities. The initiative forms part of NLMC's continued efforts to facilitate the monetisation of surplus and underutilised public assets through transparent, market-driven and technology-enabled processes, while promoting their productive utilisation. Residential Properties Across Three Locations The proposed e-auction comprises 11 ready-built residential flats distributed across three housing schemes in Prayagraj, offering prospective buyers a choice of two-bedroom and three-bedroom residential units. The properties are located in established residential neighbourhoods with access to educational institutions, healthcare facilities, commercial establishments and other essential civic amenities. The details of the properties are as follows: Housing Scheme Location No. of Flats Configuration Juhi Housing Scheme Muir Road, Prayagraj 5 2 BHK Parivartan Housing Scheme Thornhill Road, Prayagraj 4 2 BHK and 3 BHK Agnipath Housing Scheme T.B. Sapru Road, Civil Lines, Prayagraj 2 3 BHK Total 11 The five flats at Juhi Housing Scheme have built-up areas ranging from approximately 107 to 108 square metres. The four flats at Parivartan Housing Scheme range from approximately 106 to 139 square metres, while the two flats at Agnipath Housing Scheme have built-up areas of approximately 96 and 112 square metres. These properties present an opportunity for prospective homebuyers seeking residential accommodation in established neighbourhoods of Prayagraj, as well as investors exploring long-term residential property ownership. Important Dates and E-Auction Schedule NLMC has announced the following schedule for the e-auction process: Particulars Date and Time RFP Release 5 November 2026 Pre-Bid Meeting 20 November 2026 at 11:00 AM Last Date for Registration and Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) Submission 7 December 2026 by 5:00 PM E-Auction 11 December 2026, 11:00 AM to 5:00 PM A Pre-Bid Meeting will be held on 20 November 2026 at 11:00 AM to provide prospective bidders an opportunity to seek clarifications regarding the auction process, eligibility conditions, documentation requirements, payment procedures and other relevant provisions of the RFP. Interested bidders are encouraged to participate in the pre-bid process and complete the necessary registration and EMD submission formalities within the prescribed timelines. Registration and Participation The e-auction will be conducted through a digital auction platform, enabling eligible participants to submit competitive bids in accordance with the terms and conditions specified in the RFP. Prospective bidders, homebuyers and investors are invited to explore the residential properties and participate in the forthcoming e-auction. The RFP, detailed property particulars, eligibility requirements, EMD provisions, bidding procedures and other terms and conditions may be accessed through the designated e-auction portal. E-Auction Portal: https://eauction.enivida.com Last Date for Registration and EMD Submission: 7 December 2026, 5:00 PM E-Auction Date: 11 December 2026, 11:00 AM to 5:00 PM Interested participants are advised to carefully review the RFP and complete all prescribed formalities before the stipulated deadline. About NLMC The National Land Monetization Corporation (NLMC) is a wholly owned Government of India company under the administrative control of the Department of Public Enterprises, Ministry of Finance. NLMC was established to facilitate the monetisation of surplus land and building assets of Central Public Sector Enterprises (CPSEs) and other government entities, in line with the Government of India's broader asset monetisation objectives. Through its initiatives, NLMC seeks to unlock the economic potential of surplus public assets, promote their productive utilisation and contribute to efficient public asset management and national economic development.
